instagram.caption:
This Game Boy was burned in a bombing during the Gulf War. It still works.

Its owner, a US serviceman, mailed the melted console to Nintendo hoping it could be repaired. The technicians put a Tetris cartridge in and it turned on.

Nintendo sent him a new one and kept the burned Game Boy on display in its New York store for years, still running Tetris.

What's the toughest console you ever owned?
